title: Figure 1. Electrothermal Arcjet Thruster – 30-kW arcjet tested at JPL
description: Color photograph of a glowing orange plume from an arcjet thruster against a dark background, with an inset label reading "30-kW Lab-Model Ammonia Arcjet Firing into a Gas-Dynamic Diffuser at JPL." Captioned "Figure 1. Electrothermal Arcjet Thruster. Photograph of a 30-kW arcjet thruster being tested at the Jet Propulsion Laboratory." Surrounding text compares jet power of aircraft, rockets, and electric propulsion systems.
